scripts.dev:api: conda run --no-capture-output -n base python -m uvicorn apps.api.app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --log-level info --access-log
scripts.build: npm --workspace @mock-interview/core run build && npm --workspace @mock-interview/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @mock-interview/core run lint && npm --workspace @mock-interview/web run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:api: conda run -n base python -m pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @mock-interview/core run typecheck && npm --workspace @mock-interview/web run typecheck
